output.summary: Evergreen conifer trees now largely confined to the Southern Hemisphere, including New Caledonia, eastern Australia, New Guinea and southern South America. Many are large, with horizontal branches arranged in whorls and leathery or needle-like leaves; their rounded female cones contain large edible seeds.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds of A. araucana, A. angustifolia and A. bidwillii are eaten, particularly by several Indigenous peoples.
